title: The rows show while the setting is off, with no hints
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location is connected to QuickBooks Online and that AccountingHub is not enabled.
  • Have a new No Charge category for this test, category A, with no account.
custom_steps:
1. Open Integrations > QuickBooks.
  2. Open ShopView Accounts.
  3. Pick an expense account in category A's row.
  4. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The QuickBooks page opens.

Step 2:

  • The category rows show under Cost of Parts.
  • Category A's empty row shows no hint.

Step 3:

  • The account shows.

Step 4:

  • The mapping is saved although the setting is off.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11762 (Story 5, QuickBooks Online account mapping), story SV-12295 (Story 13, Release day, seeding and migration)

  • S5-R5: “The rows are shown whether or not the Internal Work Orders setting is on, so the accountant can map ahead of time.”
  • S5-R4: “While a category row is empty, the row shows the existing empty-row hint with the text "Not set. Parts cost of [category] work orders posts to the ShopView Review account until you pick one." There is no fallback from one row to another. While the setting is off, empty rows show no hint.”
  • Key Decisions: “No feature flag. Rationale: the setting under Work Orders is off by default, so existing shops see no change until they turn it on; that is the release-day protection.”
